en-US.title: BruLogger: Coffee Journal
en-US.subtitle: Log, rate & dial in every brew
en-US.description:
BruLogger is a simple journal for the coffee you make at home. Log each brew, rate how it tasted, and learn what you like, so your next cup is better than your last.

LOG EVERY BREW
• Pour over, espresso, AeroPress, French press, cold brew and more
• The coffee: name, roaster, origin, roast level, varietal and process
• The recipe: grind size, dose, yield, water temperature and brew time
• A photo of the cup, the bag or your setup

TASTE AND RATE
• Star ratings in half steps
• An optional flavor profile (aromatics, acidity, sweetness, aftertaste and body), drawn as a radar chart
• Flavor notes, and anything else worth remembering for next time

SEE WHAT WORKS
• Search your whole history and filter by method, roast or rating
• Follow your ratings over time
• See your favorite methods and roasts, and your average flavor profile

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your brews and photos are visible only to you
• No ads and no tracking
• Delete your account and everything in it at any time, right from the app

ON YOUR PHONE AND THE WEB
Sign in at brulogger.com with the same account and your brews are there too.

BruLogger is free.
en-US.promoText: Dial in your coffee at home: log each brew's recipe, rate how it tasted, and see what works. Free, private and ad-free.
